name: Thomas Marcelle
headline: Helping B2B companies grow through LinkedIn creators | Co-founder @NaanoX

sections.bio:
I started building little projects when I was 15 and I never really stopped.

Today, I’m building NaanoX.

Naano is a performance-based LinkedIn creator marketplace for B2B teams: brands partner with creators, campaigns are tracked, and payouts are tied to results.

If you’re running growth/marketing at a tech company and you want to test creator-led distribution in a structured way send me a message or sign up: naano.xyz

Based in Paris

posts.text:
NaanoX is already scheduling new campaigns for October.
⠀
We came back from summer to a very different calendar.
⠀
We now spend our weeks on several dozen calls with companies that want to launch creator campaigns.
⠀
At the same time, around 50 creators sign up every day.
⠀
And on average, a company can create its account and see its first creator post go live 48 hours later.
⠀
It means a company can talk to us on Tuesday and have creators publishing before the end of the week.
⠀
Most days now look like that:
⠀
- A call with a new company.
- New creators joining in the background.
- And campaigns going live at the same time.
⠀
In a few verticals, September is already full.
⠀
So the new campaigns we're discussing today are being planned for October.
⠀
Not a bad way to start the rentrée 🦄

Claude can now manage your entire LinkedIn influence.
​
We plugged Claude and Codex into the same infrastructure we use to run creator campaigns.
​
Now they can:

- Find the right creators.
- Negotiate their rates.
- Handle the contracts.
- Track every post.
- Measure the results.
​
We used this setup on a €20k campaign.

The results:

- 900k+ impressions.
- Around €22 CPM.
- Hundreds of signups.
- Positive ROI.

(And yes, it can now tell which creator generated which revenue as well.)
​
I put together the exact setup we use, including the installation guide, the MCP and the prompts.
​

On August 25, a client launched their own campaign on NaanoX.
They wanted creators to publish their posts before the end of August.
⠀
That gave them one week.
⠀
They sent 25 collaboration requests directly through the marketplace.
⠀
→ 22 creators accepted within 2 days.
→ 18 posts went live within the week.
⠀
This is exactly why we're building a marketplace.
⠀
Brands choose the creators they want to work with and send their collaboration requests directly on NaanoX.
⠀
Creators decide which campaigns to accept. Brands run their campaigns themselves.
⠀
For this client, that meant starting on August 25 and still getting 18 posts published in August.
⠀
Seeing those requests turn into actual posts so quickly is one of the most satisfying parts of building this.
⠀
We want brands to be able to launch creator campaigns when they need them. This campaign is a concrete example of that.
⠀
Planning a creator campaign for September? Find your creators on NaanoX → https://naano.com/

We've paid out nearly 100K to creators since we started NaanoX.

That's a pretty cool sentence to write.

When you're building a company, you spend so much time thinking about the next feature, the next client, the next thing that needs fixing.

Then you look at a number like this and remember that people are actually earning money through what you built.

People who spend time sharing what they know, testing products and building an audience that trusts them.

I'm proud that Naano.com gets to be part of that.

And I want a lot more creators to have access to those opportunities.

Want to be part of the next 100K we pay out?

You don’t need 50K followers to get paid for your LinkedIn content.

Join NaanoX and find B2B brands to work with → naano.com

We just paid $4,000 for 5 letters.
⠀
naano.com
⠀
Some investments require a spreadsheet, 3 meetings and a lot of convincing.
⠀
This one was simpler.
⠀
naano.xyz was perfect when NaanoX was an idea we were building from scratch.
⠀
But it no longer felt serious enough for where we’re heading.
⠀
So we bought the .com.
⠀
And brand-new landing pages to match.
⠀
Please click on naano.com so we can start making the $4,000 back
